fia.1.d.simp_chinese: [SCOPE.sState('fia_event_state').GetName]的宗教社群要求政府回应。当地紧张度：[SCOPE.sState('fia_event_state').MakeScope.Var('fia_tension').GetValue|0]/100。
fia.1.d.english: Religious communities in [SCOPE.sState('fia_event_state').GetName] demand a response. Local tension: [SCOPE.sState('fia_event_state').MakeScope.Var('fia_tension').GetValue|0]/100.

fia.1.f.simp_chinese: 矛盾来自政策限制与地方困境；不同信仰本身不构成罪责。
fia.1.f.english: Policy restrictions and local hardship drive the dispute; difference of faith alone is no wrongdoing.

fia.1.a.simp_chinese: 调解：紧张度−15，持续缓和一年；承担行政成本。
fia.1.a.english: Mediate: −15 tension, one year of conciliation; pay an administrative cost.

fia.1.b.simp_chinese: 调查：紧张度−5，承担半年的行政成本。
fia.1.b.english: Investigate: −5 tension; pay six months of administrative costs.

fia.1.c.simp_chinese: 镇压：紧张度+10，产生重大事件并增加激进者。
fia.1.c.english: Repress: +10 tension, a documented incident and more radicals.

fia.2.d.simp_chinese: [SCOPE.sCountry('fia_event_host').GetName]境内[SCOPE.sState('fia_event_state').GetName]的同教社群请求介入。我们可以先提出五年地方保障要求。
fia.2.d.english: A community sharing our state faith in [SCOPE.sState('fia_event_state').GetName], [SCOPE.sCountry('fia_event_host').GetName], requests intervention. We may first seek a five-year local guarantee.

fia.2.f.simp_chinese: 保护意味着承诺；交涉失败并不自动宣战。
fia.2.f.english: Protection creates obligations. Failed talks do not automatically mean war.

fia.2.a.simp_chinese: 提出保障要求，等待对方回应。
fia.2.a.english: Request guarantees and await a response.

fia.2.b.simp_chinese: 不承担这项承诺，进入三年干涉冷却。
fia.2.b.english: Decline this commitment; take a three-year intervention cooldown.

fia.3.d.simp_chinese: [SCOPE.sCountry('fia_event_patron').GetName]要求保障[SCOPE.sState('fia_event_state').GetName]的宗教活动，停止当地镇压并接受五年监督。
fia.3.d.english: [SCOPE.sCountry('fia_event_patron').GetName] requests safeguards for religious activity in [SCOPE.sState('fia_event_state').GetName], an end to local repression and five years of monitoring.

fia.3.f.simp_chinese: 这是一项地方行政安排，不会改变国教、全国法律或人口信仰。拒绝将给予对方一年内提出宗教保障外交博弈的理由。
fia.3.f.english: This is a local administrative arrangement. It changes neither the state faith, national laws nor anyone’s religion. Refusal grants a one-year opportunity to raise a religious-guarantee diplomatic play.

fia.3.a.simp_chinese: 接受五年保障，承担地方成本及教权派反弹。
fia.3.a.english: Accept five-year guarantees, local costs and a Devout backlash.

fia.4.d.simp_chinese: 地方镇压停止，五年履约期开始。保护国持续承担50外交影响力与25行政力成本；地方承担5%税收损失并获得0.5生活水平。
fia.4.d.english: Local repression ends and a five-year compliance period begins. The protector pays 50 Influence and 25 Bureaucracy; the locality loses 5% tax collection and gains 0.5 Standard of Living.

fia.4.f.simp_chinese: 没有人口被立即改宗，法律接纳程度也不会被这份行政安排直接改写。
fia.4.f.english: No population is instantly converted, and this administrative arrangement does not directly alter legal acceptance.

fia.5.t.simp_chinese: 交涉破裂或保障被撤销

fia.5.d.simp_chinese: 一年内可以提出“保障宗教权利”外交博弈。必须仍满足地区利益、同教联系、有效危机及原版外交条件；现有停战协定不会被绕过。
fia.5.d.english: A religious-guarantee diplomatic play may be raised for one year, provided regional interest, a shared faith, a live crisis and vanilla diplomatic conditions remain valid. Existing truces are respected.

fia.5.f.simp_chinese: 我们可以通过外交视图选择目标，也可以撤回承诺。战争不会自动开始。
fia.5.f.english: Use the diplomatic view to select the target, or withdraw the commitment. War does not begin automatically.

fia.6.d.simp_chinese: 地方保障已履行60个月。监督成本结束，保护国获得两年外交信誉修正，并进入三年干涉冷却。
fia.6.d.english: Local guarantees have lasted 60 months. Monitoring costs end; the protector receives two years of diplomatic credit and a three-year intervention cooldown.

fia.6.f.simp_chinese: 条约的价值在履约中体现。
fia.6.f.english: The value of a treaty lies in its execution.

fia.7.t.simp_chinese: 宗教矛盾成为公开危机

fia.7.d.simp_chinese: 某地区紧张度达到50，持续矛盾已形成重大事件记录。达到70后，具备同教联系和当地利益的外国可能收到保护请求。
fia.7.d.english: A locality has reached 50 tension. Persistent unrest now constitutes a documented incident. At 70, a foreign country sharing the community’s faith and holding a regional interest may receive a protection petition.

fia.7.f.simp_chinese: 及时调解或改善政教政策仍然可以缓和矛盾。
fia.7.f.english: Mediation or reform of religious policy can still defuse the dispute.

fia.8.d.simp_chinese: 目标：[SCOPE.sCountry('fia_event_host').GetName]；地区：[SCOPE.sState('fia_event_state').GetName]。在外交视图的外交博弈列表中选择“保障宗教权利”，再选择该地区。此入口由原版检查外交限制和战争代价。
fia.8.d.english: Target: [SCOPE.sCountry('fia_event_host').GetName]; locality: [SCOPE.sState('fia_event_state').GetName]. In the diplomatic lens, choose Protect Religious Rights and select this state. The native interface checks diplomatic restrictions and war costs.

fia.8.f.simp_chinese: 初始目标花费5恶名、20调动筹码，需控制目标地区；胜利只执行地方保障，不转移领土。
fia.8.f.english: The starting goal costs 5 Infamy and 20 Maneuvers and requires control of the target state. Enforcement grants local guarantees without transferring territory.

fia_revoke_guarantees.simp_chinese: 撤销所有地方宗教保障

fia_review_crisis_desc.simp_chinese: 选择本国紧张度最高且未处于保障期的地区。每年最多处理一次。
fia_review_crisis_desc.english: Review the most tense unprotected locality. Available once a year.

fia_review_intervention_desc.simp_chinese: 查看当前目标与外交博弈操作说明。本决议不会直接宣战。
fia_review_intervention_desc.english: Review the current target and instructions for the native diplomatic play. This decision does not declare war.

fia_withdraw_protection_desc.simp_chinese: 撤回当前承诺并停止监督成本。已生效的地方保障继续履行，且不会给予保护国完成奖励。
fia_withdraw_protection_desc.english: Withdraw the commitment and end monitoring costs. Existing local guarantees continue, without awarding completion credit to the former protector.

fia_revoke_guarantees_desc.simp_chinese: 同时撤销本国所有有效保障，紧张度设为80；仍存在的保护国得到一年交涉理由。原版停战协定仍有效。
fia_revoke_guarantees_desc.english: Revoke every active guarantee, set local tension to 80, and grant surviving protectors a one-year reason to intervene. Vanilla truces still apply.

fia_revoke_guarantees_tooltip.simp_chinese: 撤销所有地方宗教保障

je_fia_overview_reason.simp_chinese: 宗教限制与地方动乱可能形成危机。25紧张度触发国内处置，50形成重大事件，70允许外国提出保护请求。查看决议以处置争端。
je_fia_overview_reason.english: Religious restrictions combined with local turmoil can create a crisis: domestic response at 25 tension, a major incident at 50, foreign protection requests at 70. Use Decisions to respond.

je_fia_overview_status.simp_chinese: 受关注地区：[JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('fia_case_count').GetValue|0]；最高紧张度：[JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('fia_max_tension').GetValue|0]/100；宗教干涉疲劳：[JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('fia_fatigue').GetValue|0]/100。
je_fia_overview_status.english: Tracked localities: [JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('fia_case_count').GetValue|0]; maximum tension: [JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('fia_max_tension').GetValue|0]/100; intervention fatigue: [JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('fia_fatigue').GetValue|0]/100.

je_fia_intervention_reason.simp_chinese: 先提出地方保障要求；遭拒后可在一年内通过外交视图提出保障宗教权利。达成保障后承担五年监督成本。可以在没有进行中的博弈或战争时撤回。
je_fia_intervention_reason.english: Seek local guarantees first. Refusal opens a one-year window to raise Protect Religious Rights in the diplomatic lens. An agreement requires five years of monitoring. Withdraw when no related play or war is in progress.

je_fia_intervention_status.simp_chinese: 目标地区紧张度：[JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('fia_display_tension')|0]/100；护教压力以该紧张度表示。履约：[JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('fia_display_accord_months')|0]/60个月。
je_fia_intervention_status.english: Local tension / protection pressure: [JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('fia_display_tension')|0]/100. Compliance: [JournalEntry.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('fia_display_accord_months')|0]/60 months.

dp_fia_protect_faith_desc.simp_chinese: 通过外交博弈要求目标地区停止宗教镇压并接受五年地方保障。
dp_fia_protect_faith_desc.english: Demand an end to religious repression and five years of local guarantees through a diplomatic play.

fia_religious_guarantees_desc.simp_chinese: 停止目标地区的镇压并执行五年地方保障；不转移领土、不改变全国法律、不立即改宗人口。
fia_religious_guarantees_desc.english: End repression in the target state and enforce five years of local guarantees. No land transfer, national law change or instant population conversion.

war_goal_fia_religious_guarantees_desc.simp_chinese: 停止目标地区的镇压并执行五年地方保障；不转移领土、不改变全国法律、不立即改宗人口。
war_goal_fia_religious_guarantees_desc.english: End repression in the target state and enforce five years of local guarantees. No land transfer, national law change or instant population conversion.

war_goal_fia_religious_guarantees_type_d.simp_chinese: 停止目标地区的镇压并执行五年地方保障；不转移领土、不改变全国法律、不立即改宗人口。
war_goal_fia_religious_guarantees_type_d.english: End repression in the target state and enforce five years of local guarantees. No land transfer, national law change or instant population conversion.

war_goal_fia_religious_guarantees_sway_d.simp_chinese: 停止目标地区的镇压并执行五年地方保障；不转移领土、不改变全国法律、不立即改宗人口。
war_goal_fia_religious_guarantees_sway_d.english: End repression in the target state and enforce five years of local guarantees. No land transfer, national law change or instant population conversion.
